name: ESP32-S3-DevKitC-1 (N8R8)
description: Official ESP32-S3 board with WROOM-1 N8R8 (8 MB flash, 8 MB octal PSRAM), native USB plus a UART bridge, addressable RGB LED and 2x22 breadboard pins; the default for S3/AI/camera/display work.
notes: Two Micro-USB ports: one through a CP2102N UART bridge, one wired to the S3 native USB (CDC/JTAG, GPIO19/20).
36 header GPIOs, but the N8R8 octal PSRAM/flash reserves GPIO35, 36 and 37, leaving 33 usable (N8/N8R2 modules keep them free).
Addressable RGB LED on GPIO38 (v1.1; v1.0 used GPIO48). Strapping pins: GPIO0, 3, 45, 46.
Size includes ~6 mm antenna overhang (PCB 62.74 mm). Many $7-12 AliExpress clones exist, often with USB-C and N16R8 modules; header order is the same.
Variants: -1U has an external antenna connector; N32R16V uses a WROOM-2 module.
